extraction.name: NWPU-RESISC45
extraction.description: A publicly available large-scale benchmark dataset for remote sensing image scene classification containing 31,500 images across 45 scene classes with 700 images per class.
extraction.creator: Northwestern Polytechnical University (NWPU)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed by first selecting 45 representative scene classes, then extracting remote sensing images from Google Earth by experts in remote sensing image interpretation. Images cover more than 100 countries and regions worldwide and were carefully selected under varied weather, season, illumination, imaging, and scale conditions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Remote sensing images extracted from Google Earth, which superimposes satellite imagery, aerial photography, and GIS onto a 3D globe.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Images were divided into 45 scene classes, each class containing 700 images of size 256×256 pixels in RGB color space.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were extracted and standardized to 256×256 pixels in RGB color space.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Scene classes were defined during dataset construction, and images were extracted by experts in remote sensing image interpretation into 45 scene categories.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Experts in the field of remote sensing image interpretation.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Geography/location information covering more than 100 countries and regions worldwide.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to enable the community to develop and evaluate new data-driven algorithms and improve the state of the art in remote sensing image scene classification.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The paper states that existing datasets have limitations including small scale of scene classes and image numbers, lack of image variations and diversity, and saturation of accuracy. For the proposed NWPU-RESISC45 dataset, it notes that SIRI-WHU mainly covers urban areas in China and hence lacks diversity, and that their own dataset covers more than 100 countries and regions and was designed to have rich variations, high within-class diversity, and between-class similarity. No explicit harmful bias analysis is provided for NWPU-RESISC45 beyond these representativeness and diversity considerations.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Some classes such as island, lake, mountain, and snowberg have lower spatial resolutions than most other scene classes.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking, developing, evaluating, and testing remote sensing image scene classification methods, including data-driven and deep learning algorithms.
